title: Determination of the Charge Placed on a Granite Ridge Pass Account for Restoring Scanning Privileges
content:
Scanning privileges that have been withdrawn are restored on the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass record, and this rule fixes the charge placed on the pass account for the restoration.

**The base of the charge.** The base of the charge is the reinstatement fee the tier carries, taken once.

**The refusals left uncured.** The refusals left uncured past their grace period are counted as the late fees raised on the pass account in the cycle of the handling date, which is the one whole month ending on that date.

**Relief for a refusal the payment method recorded as the card having expired.** No relief is given on that head.

**Relief for a season the holder has not used.** No relief is given on that head.

**Relief for how the pass record was opened.** No relief is given on that head.

**How the reliefs act.** The reliefs are first added together into one total relief rate and the base of the charge is reduced once by that total rate; the reliefs do not act one after another on what the previous relief has left.

**The restoration charge.** The restoration charge is the base of the charge less that single reduction, never below zero, and it is rounded to the cent only once the reduction has been taken.

### The determination worked through

Hypothetical inputs: a pass on a tier whose reinstatement fee is 49.00, restored on a handling date on which the pass account shows one late fee of 29.00 raised in the cycle of that date.

The base of the charge is the tier's reinstatement fee taken once, 49.00. The three heads of relief each give nothing, so the rates they contribute are 0, 0 and 0 and the total relief rate is 0. The base is reduced once by that total rate, which leaves 49.00, and the figure is rounded to the cent once the reduction has been taken. The restoration charge is 49.00.

The refusals left uncured past their grace period are counted as the late fees raised in the cycle of the handling date, which on this account is one.
